title: Los Angeles weather: Southern California to see warm temperatures before rain arrives end of week - ABC7 Los Angeles
text:
Los Angeles weather: Southern California to see warm temperatures before rain arrives end of week - ABC7 Los Angeles 
 24/7 Live Los Angeles Orange County Inland Empire Ventura County California Weather 
 SoCal to see warm temperatures before rain arrives by end of week 
 Southern California could see rain again by the end of the week, but the region will first have to deal with summer-like temperatures. KABC Tuesday, November 10, 2026 3:42PM Share Follow ABC7 on Google Este artículo se ofrece en Español LOS ANGELES (KABC) -- Southern California could see rain again by the end of the week, but the region will first have to deal with summer-like temperatures.
 Warm and dry conditions with sunny skies are expected through the middle of the week, with slight cooling coming on Thursday.
 ABC7 has issued a Weather Change Alert for Friday, when showers could arrive and continue into early next week. Expect temperatures to drop into the 70s.
 A coastal flood advisory remains through noon Tuesday along the coast. Expect high tides of 7.2 to 7.4 feet.
 A high surf advisory will also be in effect for beaches in Ventura and L.A. counties.
 Tuesday forecast
 Los Angeles and Orange counties on Tuesday can expect a high of 89 degrees with a low of 62. Expect similar conditions Wednesday. Rain chances and cooler temperatures move in by the weekend.
 The valleys and the Inland Empire will see a high of 90 degrees and a low of 53 on Tuesday. Similar conditions are on tap Wednesday.
 Beach communities can expect sunny conditions on Tuesday, with a high of 82 degrees and a low of 64.
 Mountain areas will see sunny skies on Tuesday, with a high of 62 degrees and a low of 36. Expect sunshine and afternoon highs in the low 60s through Thursday.
 Deserts are expected to reach a high of 76 degrees and a low of 36 on Tuesday. Palm Springs is expected to reach a high of 88 degrees.
